MR Safety
The Nova Spinal System is MR Conditional. A person with the Nova Spinal System may be safely scanned under the following conditions. Failure to follow these conditions may result in injury.
Parameter Condition
Device Name Nova Spinal System
Static Magnetic Field Strength (B0) 1.5 T
B0 Field Orientation Horizontal
Maximum Spatial Field Gradient 30 T/m
RF Excitation Circularly Polarized (CP)
RF Conditions B1+rms must not exceed 3.2 microtesla
Scan Regions Only head and lower extremity landmarks are permitted
Image Artifact The image artifact extends approximately 2 mm from the device.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
